name: Stones of Binding
label: Quest
description: After The Princess Trapped, a voice from the iridescent shards tells of four Stones of Binding spread across Arathi that hold it down under the ground.…
intro: After The Princess Trapped, a voice from the iridescent shards tells of four Stones of Binding spread across Arathi that hold it down under the ground. The strongest, the Stone of Inner Binding, can be unlocked only with keys taken from the other three.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Four Stones of Binding are scattered throughout Arathi. These stones keep me pinned beneath the earth.
To unlock them you must unlock the strongest: the Stone of Inner Binding. And to do that, you must gather keys from the other three.
These stones are watched by guardians, but if you are clever, or lucky, you may find ways to banish them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: This is the Stone of Inner Binding. It is the strongest of the binding stones and must be unlocked for the others to open.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done it! You opened the Stones of Binding! I can feel the shackles about me loosen, and freedom draws ever closer.
You are a noble adventurer, friend. My rescuer!
